brief: A slice of the programme. Say what the slice delivers as a whole, what it unblocks downstream, and how a reader will know it is finished. Not a list of its children.
One shippable deliverable. Say what it is, who needs it, and what acceptance looks like.

One step inside its story's own workflow. Say what the role holding it is actually doing right now — writing this code, running this research, reviewing this diff — the inputs it is working from, and what closes it. Never a restatement of the story it belongs to; the story already says what that is.
